title: Wack100 Brings Tekashi 6ix9ine & DJ Akademiks To Clubhouse, But DJ Akademics Was A No Show [Listen]
htmlContent:
On Thursday evening Wack 100 was able to get Tekashi 6ix9ine back on Clubhouse following the news that Gunna had been released. The Clubhouse room that was hosting the conversation was 100 Ent. The Conversation was supposed to feature 6ix9ine, Wack 100, and DJ Akademiks.

However, Akademiks did not actually show up for the conversation focused on the video that was shared to the public by WSBTV in Atlanta, GA.

Where Gunna accepted a plea deal, which allow him to be freed.

"When I became affiliated with YSL in 2016, I did not consider it a "gang"; more like a group of people from metro Atlanta who had common interests and artistic aspirations.

"My focus of YSL was entertainment - rap artists who wrote and performed music that exaggerated and "glorified" urban life in the Black community.

"While I have agreed to always be truthful, I want to make it perfectly clear that I have NOT made any statements, have NOT been interviewed, have NOT cooperated, have NOT agreed to testify or be a witness for or against any party in the case and have absolutely NO intention of being involved in the trial process in any way.

"I have chosen to end my own RICO case with an Alford plea and end my personal ordeal by publicly acknowledging my association with YSL. An Alford plea in my case is the entry of a guilty plea to the one charge against me, which is in my best interest, while at the same time maintaining my innocence toward the same charge. I love and cherish my association with YSL music, and always will. I look at this as an opportunity to give back to my community and educate young men and women that "gangs" and violence only lead to destruction."

Gunna shared according to Fox 5 Atlanta.

Back to the conversation on Clubhouse, 6ix9ine revealed reason Akademiks is a afraid of individuals from Atlanta.

"Yo Wack, where this n*** Akademiks? That n*** Akademiks is afraid of them Atlanta n***s. He don't even want to come up here, " said Tekashi 6ix9ine.

Wack added, I know I don't know where that n*** at. He be calling me every other day," said Wack 100.

6ix9ine: Atlanta has been the quietest that I have ever seen them all f***ing day. All of them n***s are quiet right now. They don't know what to say. They phone calls are ring ring. Yo, what should we say, just stay quiet for now

Wack 100: I'm going put it on the whole Atlanta

6ix9ine: I put on the whole Atlanta.

Speaking about 6ix9ine, according to TMZ reported 6ix9ine had been banned from SLS Lux Property after one of the rapper’s friends — Nelk Boys member SteveWillDoIt — received a letter sent by attorneys for the apartment complex.

While Clubhouse 6ix9ine shared it wasn't a apartment it was penthouse and he wasn't affiliated with the security.
